title: grass cyberdeck (allat to play pokemon yellow 🥀). thoughts ↓ cyberdec...
description: grass cyberdeck (allat to play pokemon yellow 🥀). thoughts ↓ cyberdecks were never about making the “best” computer. they came out of Neuromancer (yes, i wrote my senior essay on it) as messy, personal machines. now it’s a whole maker subculture, but the core’s the same: control + identity + a quiet resistance to how polished tech has become. this one’s a grass cyberdeck, wood + moss + exposed parts. something that feels a little alive, a little off. built on a Raspberry Pi, nothing fancy. honestly a simple build, just wanted to show how easy it is to make something like this in your bedroom (i post my pc a lot, but this is just as cool). it’s not trying to compete with a GeForce RTX 4090 or be practical. it’s more about rejecting the “black box” (our everyday sealed, untouchable devices) and leaning into radical ownership, something you can open, understand, and actually call yours. more optimization soon :) #cyberdeck #pokemonyellow #reelsinstagram #hardware

title: most of what i post here is a paper trail of my career and tech. it’s...
description: most of what i post here is a paper trail of my career and tech. it’s intentional, but it’s a lopsided portrait. this is something a little more personal. after moving to new york this year, i was convinced i was “falling behind” because i wasn’t constantly producing. but looking back, the actual architecture of my year was built in the gaps. it was the side quests that went nowhere, the hobbies i kept secret so i wouldn’t have to monetize them, and the quiet labor of learning to be alone in a city of 8 million people (lol). we talk a lot about ‘optimization’ but the art of being human is gloriously inefficient. i’m grateful for a year where i finally learned how to govern myself (to restock the groceries on time, to pause without guilt, and to err on the side of technical creativity instead of performative motion). still don’t know exactly where i’m going, but i know i’m closer than i was last January. that feels like progress (even if it doesn’t photograph well). most of all, if you’ve been here since i accidentally made this song viral years ago, or you just found me yesterday through a random reel: thank you for sticking with me. letting other people witness your life, even the ordinary parts, is a strange privilege. i don’t take it lightly. 🫀 #newyear

title: lovely oncall nights 🤗 jokes aside, oncall is a normal part of softwa...
description: lovely oncall nights 🤗 jokes aside, oncall is a normal part of software engineering but doesn’t get talked about enough. most teams with customer-facing products have rotations, and many don’t pay overtime. some teams get paged constantly, others rarely. it varies wildly, but it’s part of the deal when you own production systems. #oncall #softwareengineer
